subject: AstraNova RFP: control heatmap & evidence pull
messages:
From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@astranova.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: AstraNova Procurement <procurement@astranova.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: RFP follow-up: control heatmap & evidence pull

Marcus —

Thanks again for the demo last week. AstraNova procurement has picked Redwood as a shortlisted vendor for the enterprise search project, and our security/compliance team needs a focused deliverable to close the SIG portion of the RFP. Specifically we need:

- A control heatmap mapping your controls to the SIG shared assessments v2.0 control IDs (we use SIG v2.0).
- Representative evidence for high-risk controls (SOC 2 Type II report, ISO scope, KMS key rotation logs, network diagram).
- A completed SIG questionnaire export (CSV or XLSX) with your internal control owner and control frequency columns populated.

Deadline: we need the heatmap + evidence packet by COB Apr 6 to stay on our procurement cadence. If that timeline is tight, let us know what subset you can provide by Apr 6 and what you can follow up with.

Format preferences: a single zipped packet with a control-heatmap (CSV), an evidence index (PDF), and the artifacts. Secure transfer via your SFTP or our secure upload portal is fine. We also accept a link to a shared drive.

Let me know if you want to set a quick call to triage the ask and split responsibilities — Evan

--
Evan Cole
Senior Procurement Manager, AstraNova
procurement@astranova.com
AstraNova | www.astranova.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Evan Cole <evan.cole@astranova.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: control heatmap & evidence pull

Thanks Evan — we can meet that timeline with a targeted set of artifacts. Looping in Neha (security), Jasmine (customer success / onboarding), and Ben (sales ops) to coordinate.

Quick plan:
- Deliverable by Apr 6: SIG control heatmap (CSV) mapped to our SOC 2 and ISO controls, SOC 2 Type II redacted report, ISO 27001 scope statement, and a network diagram.
- Follow-up by Apr 13: additional artifact samples (KMS rotation logs, select runbooks, and an export of our SIG questionnaire).

Neha — can you confirm we can share a redacted SOC2 Type II and the ISO scope? Jasmine — please prepare a copy of the SIG questionnaire export and an evidence index template. Ben — I'll coordinate the SFTP/share link and any notes on acceptable redaction.

If AstraNova prefers a short triage call, propose Wed Mar 31 10:00am PT — 20 minutes.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
--
Attachments referenced: redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf (redacted), redwood_iso_scope_2026.pdf

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com, jasmine_liu@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 30 Mar 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: AstraNova SIG / evidence task list (ownership)

Team —

Summarizing work items and owners so we hit the Apr 6 packet deadline:

1) Control heatmap (SIG v2.0 mapping) — Owner: Neha Kapoor. Deliverable: CSV with columns: SIG_Control_ID, SIG_Control_Name, Redwood_Control_ID, Redwood_Control_Description, Control_Owner, Evidence_File_Name, Frequency. Due: Apr 5 EOD.

2) SOC 2 Type II (redacted PDF) — Owner: Neha Kapoor / Security. Confirm redaction of customer-identifying data. Deliverable: redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2026.pdf. Due: Apr 5.

3) ISO 27001 scope statement & certificate copy — Owner: Jasmine Liu. Deliverable: redwood_iso_scope_2026.pdf. Due: Apr 5.

4) KMS / key rotation evidence (sample logs & rotation policy) — Owner: Security Ops (Neha). Deliverable: kms_key_rotation_policy.pdf + sample log excerpt. Due: Apr 13 (follow-up).

5) Network diagram + boundary description — Owner: Infra (Jasmine). Deliverable: network_diagram_v3.drawio.png. Due: Apr 5.

6) SIG questionnaire export (CSV) & evidence index (PDF) — Owner: Jasmine. Deliverable: SIG_export_AN.csv, evidence_index_AN.pdf. Due: Apr 6.

Notes: keep artifacts redacted where necessary. I will prepare a short evidence index that maps file names to control IDs and a short justification for each artifact. Ben, set up the share location and add AstraNova procurement with read-only access once artifacts are ready.

Neha

From: Evan Cole <evan.cole@astranova.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: AstraNova Procurement <procurement@astranova.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: RFP follow-up: control heatmap & evidence pull

Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the plan. Wed Mar 31 call works but we ended up taking the slot for a vendor sync. No worries — we'll proceed asynchronously.

Couple of clarifications from our security reviewer: 
- For SIG mapping, please include a short rationale column when the mapping is not one-to-one (e.g., single Redwood control mapping to multiple SIG controls).
- For SOC 2, redaction is fine; we need to see your auditor firm and the period covered.
- For KMS logs, an automated sample (timestamped, showing successful rotations) is preferred rather than a long full log file.

We will provide a secure upload link after you confirm the share approach. If you can upload to your shared drive, supply that link and we'll request access, otherwise we will provide our upload portal: https://procurement.astranova.com/upload/AN-2027-031

Evan

Team —

Status update ahead of the Apr 5/6 internal cutover:
- Neha: control heatmap CSV is complete and will be validated by EOD Apr 5. It includes a short rationale column for 1:n mappings per Evan's ask.
- Jasmine: ISO scope + network diagram ready; SIG export in progress — target Apr 6 AM.
- Ben: share link created (read-only) at https://drive.redwood.com/shared/AN-2027-031-evidence-packet — set to expire in 30 days. I've invited Evan and procurement for read-only.

Planned items to deliver Apr 6: heatmap CSV, redacted SOC2 PDF, ISO scope, network diagram, SIG_export_AN.csv, and evidence_index_AN.pdf. KMS rotation sample will be uploaded as an addendum by Apr 13.

Evan — we'll upload the initial package to the drive link and notify you; if you need the procurement portal upload instead, let Ben know and he'll coordinate.

Thanks everyone — we'll keep the thread for provenance.

Marcus
